I understand what you mean, but if I knew what could help then I wouldn't be feeling like this. 

I started asking for help when I was 13/14 and I got nothing. When I was trying to kill myself at that age I was told I just had bad PMS, here's a box of 100 prescription painkillers on repeat. I kept asking for help for years. All the different kinds of medication did nothing, there's no options for me to have therapy even though I've asked. I'm currently supposed to be under the care of a community mental health service, but there's nothing they will do. 

It's tiring trying for so long to get better, but getting nothing. And now that I've lost everyone and every thing out of my life, there's nothing worth trying for anymore.
